title: Okudera Yasuhiko no Sekai o Mezase! Soccer Kids: Nyuumon-hen
native_title: 奥寺康彦の世界をめざせ! サッカー・キッズ 入門編
overview:
Kick! Trap! Dribble! Just watching this will get the basics down perfectly.

Soccer Kids: Nyuumon-hen is a soccer how-to disc for children, presented with former Japanese footballer Yasuhiko Okudera. Video clips show model demonstrations of the fundamentals, with on-screen notes that explain each point step by step.

- Technique: watch model kicks, traps and dribbles, such as stopping the ball with your chest and bringing it under control with your feet
- Impact: see the exact moment the foot meets the ball on an instep kick
- Practice: learn drills to try for yourself, like dribbling through cones set about a meter apart

キック！トラップ！ドリブル！これを見るだけで基本はバッチリ。
